name: Lanlan
description:
Tell Claude what you do and who you serve. Lanlan will build you a real website and put it on the internet. The whole process takes less than twenty minutes. Free, at a lanlan.site address, or on your own domain when you're ready.

Not a template you fight. Not a preview that goes nowhere. A real site, hosted and live, with the domain, analytics, and contact forms all in your name.

Then you maintain it the same way you made it. Add a page for the new workshop, swap the photo on your About page, or put yesterday's version back. Changes go live in seconds, and it still looks like your site, because Lanlan remembers what the two of you decided. Nothing to re-learn every time you want to update your bio.

There's a dashboard for the things you'd rather look at than ask about. Your form submissions, your traffic, your domain, every version of the site you've ever had.

Not sure about your brand yet? Most people aren't. You can start with a design conversation. Our Design Team is a handful of AI specialists who look at your site from different angles: your voice, your visuals, the people you're trying to reach. They ask you questions and debate the options in front of you. You figure out your look in the process.

Invite a teammate to build alongside you or hand the whole thing to a client. Ownership transfers in one message, and the domain, the form submissions, and the Stripe connection go with it.

We built Lanlan for the people generic tech tends to leave behind: coaches, wellness practitioners, small nonprofits, and women- and queer-owned small businesses. People with something worth offering, who shouldn't need a designer, a developer, or a weekend of tutorials to put it on the internet. Lanlan will happily build any kind of site, but those are the folks we're most excited to serve.

Lanlan is run by people who love to help. If you get stuck or something breaks, just reach out, we're glad to support however we can.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lanlan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lanlan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lanlan.site/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lanlan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lanlan lists 55 MCP tools, including add_image_from_url, analyze_site, capture_reference, check_domain, collection, componentize, connector, create_site, delete_file, delete_site, design_consultation, and design_tokens.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lanlan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lanlan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Lanlan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lanlan is developed by Lanlan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
